objective: Complete the reproducible eight-layer detailed PCB layout and keep procurement and order release blocked until signed and physical evidence exists.
acceptance: all procurement-controlled grouped BOM lines have an approval owner and evidence slots
release remains blocked until every row has an approved MPN, approver, date, and evidence reference
detailed-schematic status requires component symbols and wired connectivity rather than architecture text alone
the canonical eight-layer PCB is reproducible from the generator and checked routing session
KiCad DRC and ERC report zero violations and the connectivity and layout audits pass
oscillator load capacitors have explicit local ground returns and the protected Jetson output and exposed pad have documented current and thermal transfer geometry
CAN routing uses paired same-layer paths with matched topology while supplier field solving and impedance-coupon evidence remain open
no physical bring-up or safety approval is inferred
stop_conditions: an approver, approved orderable MPN, or datasheet revision is missing
a generated candidate has any DRC violation, unconnected pad, connectivity mismatch, or failed layout hard gate
physical prototype measurements or safety certification are required
